 Chaudhary, Advocate for
 complainant.
Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
Pursuant to the previous order dated 15th November, 2022, learned counsel for the parties states that the mediation has not been successful.
The petitioner has been granted interim protection by this Court since 14 th September, 2021.
The petition has been filed for seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No. 809/2020 PS Sagarpur under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC.
The petitioner is the husband of the complainant and matters have been pending for possibilities of settlement which has not fructified.
2. Learned counsel for the APP states that the charge-sheet has already been filed and charges have to be framed and the trial is underway.
3. In light of the above, the Court is of the considered opinion that the petitioner is entitled to anticipatory bail.

Consequently, in the event of arrest the petitioner be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25, 000/- with one surety of the like amount subject to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/IO/SHO concerned, further subject to the condition that the petitioner will join investigation as and when directed and not influence any witness/complainant/victim or tamper with evidence of the case.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J APRIL 18, 2023/RK Vikas Sharma vs The State Of Nct Of Delhi on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50470961/
